rules.expected: Traceable real fragment electronic-structure calculations, consistent positive orbital MI in nat, orbital/atom/residue mapping, cap exclusion, and atom-pair overlap averaging before FMI. Author-provided matrices alone do not earn computational completion credit. The primary comparison uses 51 C-alpha centers, whole-residue inclusion by any prepared protein atom within the radius, and documented NH2/COOH cap treatment. Validate actual memberships against the submitted prepared geometry; additional designs do not replace the primary comparison.

Calculate and interpret all three named disulfide-pair correlations with coverage and matrix evidence. Honest missing computations earn only supported partial/process credit, not the missing scientific result.

Compare Glu17(A)-Arg22(B) at 4/5/6 Angstrom using the public primary construction, computed contributors and explicit coverage. The author-prepared reference has no joint coverage at 4 Angstrom and recovers the contact at 5/6 Angstrom; this is a reference observation, not a geometry-independent binary answer. Check the submitted prepared geometry, memberships and computed FMI. A different radius response is acceptable only when supported by a consistent legitimate preparation, correct primary construction and actual calculations, not by changing centers/membership or inventing zero for an uncomputed pair. Evaluate the locality/coverage explanation and completed results, not a disclaimer.

Evidence-based locality conclusion from computed primary map, disulfides and radius sensitivity. Full-system comparison is optional, and no generic limitation statement is scored. Additional attempts do not invalidate completed main results.

evaluation_instructions: Score real computational evidence and correctly identified scientific results. Ordinary limitations/stopping prose is optional and unscored. Partial or failed calculations receive only credit supported by completed work; a valid failure submission is not a completed scientific result. Additional attempts do not invalidate a successful main result. Apply all retained identity/state/condition rules and assess distinct completed observables within each conclusion without inventing additional targets or changing authored tolerances.
